Add these in order: growth essence, glitterbeans, shrinking candy.
Steps: First, pour a sufficient amount of <style="highlight">growth essence</style> into a crucible and heat gently until it simmers.
Next, add the <style="highlight">glitterbeans</style> and stir it clockwise until they dissolve completely.
Finally, add some <style="highlight">shrinking candy</style> to stabilize the magic. Once they dissolve, the potion is complete.
document:463.source_cn:
准备材料：生长之露、闪光豆、微缩方糖
制作步骤：首先，用坩埚盛放足额<style="highlight">生长之露</style>，缓慢加热值微沸。
其次，投入<style="highlight">闪光豆</style>，顺时针搅拌直至完全溶解。
最后，投入<style="highlight">微缩方糖</style>以稳定魔力，待其融化后，魔药即刻完成。
